description:
Scope: Planning only; add tests solely in test/zaq/channels/incoming_normalization_test.exs for lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/incoming/discord.ex lines 14, 15, 52. Do not edit production files. Preserve existing assertions. No code, test, or Git execution in this planning task.

Functional specification / branches / tests to add before implementation:
1. Line 14 (fetched channel identity and metadata-map guard): construct a Jido.Chat.Incoming.new(%{external_room_id: "dm-1", channel_meta: %{chat_type: :dm, is_dm: true, external_room_id: "dm-1"}, raw: %{"channel_id" => "dm-1"}, timestamp: "2026-10-03T10:00:00Z"}). No embedded "channel" so initial normalize fails. A test-local adapter fetch_metadata/2 must return {:ok, %{id: "other", is_dm: true, metadata: %{"id" => "other", "type" => 1}}}; assert fetch called with ("dm-1", []), enrich returns the exact original incoming (no injected channel), and Incoming.normalize(incoming, :discord, adapter) == %{}. Separately return matching id but metadata: nil/list; assert same fail-closed result. These explicitly exercise both short-circuit sides of line 14. Optionally vary fetched is_dm: false to cover preceding pattern rejection.
2. Line 15 (accepted enrichment): return {:ok, %{id: "dm-1", is_dm: true, metadata: %{"id" => "dm-1", "type" => 1}}}. Assert the fetch coordinates once, enrich returns the original fields with only raw["channel"] inserted and equals expected exact map; call Incoming.normalize/3 with fresh input and assert %{conversation_type: :one_to_one, source_scope: nil, provider_sent_at: ~U[2026-10-03 10:00:00Z]}. Negative same fetched room but type 3 (or metadata id mismatch) must not normalize DM, even though enrich may insert it: fetch success alone is not authority. Keep original raw values and no guild_id.
3. Line 52 (normalize fallback): directly assert {:error, :unverified_communication_facts} for unsupported chat_type :unknown even with matching guild/channel evidence; assert same for %{chat_type: :guild, is_dm: false, external_room_id: "dm-1"} with non-map raw nil, and for nil metadata. Through Incoming.normalize/3 assert %{} for unsupported kind, not a claimed :room or :one_to_one. Existing tests already cover valid guild, thread and DM and missing DM channel evidence; do not duplicate them.

Fixtures/helpers/mocks: extend existing async: true ExUnit module; use minimal Jido.Chat.Incoming.new/1 and a nested test-only adapter fake implementing fetch_metadata/2. Store per-test return value in the test process dictionary (Process.put/get) and send(self(), {:fetch_metadata, room, opts}) to observe the boundary; assert_receive once and refute_receive additional call as appropriate. Alternatively use existing Jido.Chat.Discord.Adapter with a test-local transport fake if that proves simpler; never call Nostrum/network. No new global application config, DB/Sandbox, Mox global mode, sleeps, timers, or production test seams. If process-private fake cannot satisfy Jido adapter contract, use behavior-backed Mox in test/support with verify_on_exit! and process-private expectations instead; avoid adding mock infrastructure speculatively.

Property assessment: existing bounded contradictory-room property is for Telegram. A Discord property is appropriate if testing the broad invariant 'mismatched fetched room IDs never produce one_to_one': bounded nonempty, distinct room strings, same valid type-1 metadata; assert enrich unchanged and Incoming.normalize/3 == %{}. If a finite handful of guard cases suffices for this narrow coverage change, document why property is unnecessary; do not generate unrealistic provider payloads.

Action reuse assessment: not applicable; test-only coverage of the existing provider-local Discord.normalize/enrich and Incoming.normalize paths changes no executable operation, Action, tool, workflow, permissions or dispatch. Existing adapter fetch_metadata is reused only at the edge; no new operation or agent exposure. E2E not needed: no new UI journey or feature behavior. Documentation updates: none unless the tests reveal a contract discrepancy (then escalate separately, do not change production within coverage-only scope).

Validation for implementing agent, not performed here: run isolated mix test test/zaq/channels/incoming_normalization_test.exs (and bridge test only if integration assertions change), then mix q; check fresh coverage for the target lines using the prescribed post-review coverage phase, not stale reports. Review diff for exact assertions, fail-closed behavior and async isolation; record unreachable coverage blockers (e.g. a compile-time or adapter contract impossibility) with source evidence instead of adding test-only production hooks. Final mix precommit belongs to the approved final gate, not planning. No observed unreachable branch: lines 14/15 are reachable with a valid DM and controlled fetched metadata; line 52 is the public fallback.
title: [coverage] Cover Discord incoming enrichment and fallback lines 14, 15, 52
